title: PDF The Effect of the Minimum Wage on Teenage Employment and Unemp
text: PDF The Effect of the Minimum Wage on Teenage Employment and Unemp. In this meta-analysis, we are looked specifically at the results of a higher minimum wage on teenagers. After an exhaustive search of the available indexes, we located fourteen articles that estimated the effects of the minimum wage on teenage employment and unemployment, and which contained the necessary information for our study

title: PDF Time-Series Minimum-Wage Studies: A Meta-analysis
text: PDF Time-Series Minimum-Wage Studies: A Meta-analysis. There have been over 30 published time-series studies of the effect of the minimum wage on employment in the United States since 1970. Most of these studies correlate the employment-to-population rate of teenagers with the relative level of the minimum wage

title: Minimum Wages and Employment: A Review of Evidence from the New Minimum ...
text: Minimum Wages and Employment: A Review of Evidence from the New Minimum .... We review the burgeoning literature on the employment effects of minimum wages - in the United States and other countries - that was spurred by the new minimum wage research beginning in the early 1990s. Our review indicates that there is a wide range of existing estimates and, accordingly, a lack of consensus about the overall effects on low-wage employment of an increase in the minimum wage
